memories.headline: But somewhere between the deadlines…

items.caption: The first ever Legends photo: matching O-Week tees, tiny flags, and 69 strangers with no idea what was coming.
Where it all began, dressed up: the first time we looked like we had our lives together. It didn't last.
On Wednesdays we wear pink. Attendance: 100%, for once.
Post-MVCM: the day we finally learnt what DCP actually is. Only took us half the term.
80 plates of kulche, 1000 decibels of noise, and one very brave waiter.
We won one game of water polo. One. We will be talking about it until the end of time.
Potluck: biryani, jungle juice, a live dosa counter. Our best group project, and nobody was a silent partner.
The pre-party, which somehow always outlasted the party.
Bira Taproom, where “just one drink” was a forward-looking statement.

passage: Six months ago we were sixty-nine strangers with name tents and LinkedIn-ready introductions.

Somewhere between the case packs and the cold calls, between 2 AM Maggi and 11:59 PM submissions, the name tents stopped mattering. We learnt each other's coffee orders, each other's panic faces, each other's one joke that always works.

From here on it's electives and new sections: same campus, different classrooms, and never again all sixty-nine of us in one room. No new group chat will ever be this unhinged. But every time someone in class says “building on that…”, a Legend two rooms away is going to smile.
“Do you see what I see?” Yes: the worst chant ever written. We'll still scream it across campus every time we spot each other.
Thank you for these six months. It was a privilege to be this tired with you.

legacy.headline: Be part of the legacy.
legacy.body: Same campus, different classrooms, and never one common class again. Before the timetables split us up, leave your mark. Votes become awards, taglines become palcards, and notes become the thing we reread when the new group chats get too quiet.
